description: Estimate the clicks a keyword brings at each Google position and what moving from one position to another is worth, from monthly searches and, optionally, a conversion rate and a value per conversion. Click rates are typical published figures, not a measurement. Send numbers only (percentages as 5 for 5%). Answers a headline, the figures behind it and notes. Arithmetic on your own numbers, not financial advice. Answers from what you send alone: nothing is fetched or stored.

conversion.description: Visitors who buy or sign up (%) Optional.

currency.description: The sign money is written with; "none" for bare numbers. Default "$".

from.description: Position now. Search Console's average position. Use 30 if you're past page two.

searches.description: Monthly searches for the keyword. From a keyword tool, or Search Console impressions.

name: calculate_ctr_value
title: Estimate clicks by Google position
